nodes.name: Validate Session Token
nodes.intent_summary: Verifies that incoming HTTP Authorization header contains a valid, non-expired cryptographic HMAC signature before session hydration.

inputs.client_ip: IPv4/IPv6 client address for replay detection

business_invariants: Expired session tokens must immediately reject with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Database lookup occurs ONLY if token signature and timestamp integrity validation passes.
IP mismatch on high-privilege administrative tokens triggers immediate revocation.

nodes.name: Legacy User Principal Lookup
nodes.intent_summary: Retrieves complete user record from raw relational SQL tables and hydrates role-based permission sets.

inputs.with_roles: Boolean flag indicating whether to join legacy_roles table

outputs.user_record: User entity dictionary with permissions and status

business_invariants: Users marked 'is_suspended = 1' must be barred from all downstream write mutations.
Raw database credentials must never leak into exception stack traces.

nodes.name: Checkout Order Orchestrator
nodes.intent_summary: Coordinates item reservations, price calculations, promo deductions, and triggers payment processing.

outputs.order_receipt: Finalized OrderSummary object with order_id and status 'CONFIRMED'

business_invariants: Order total amount can never be negative, even with 100% coupon discount.
Items must be reserved in inventory before charging the payment gateway.
If payment fails, reserved inventory must roll back immediately.

nodes.name: Inventory Reservation Allocator
nodes.intent_summary: Executes atomic pessimistic lock on warehouse stock to guarantee item availability during checkout.
business_invariants: Stock counter can never decrement below zero (no backorders allowed).
Expired locks must automatically release stock back to active catalog.

nodes.name: Payment Processing & Settlement
nodes.intent_summary: Dispatches transaction tokens to payment gateway with idempotency checks and anti-fraud threshold validation.
business_invariants: Transactions exceeding $10,000 must flag as FRAUD_HOLD requiring manual compliance review.
Idempotency keys must be unique per 24-hour sliding window to prevent double charges.
Card CVV and raw PAN numbers must never be logged or persisted in storage.

nodes.name: Audit & Compliance Event Logger
nodes.intent_summary: Appends tamper-resistant, append-only logs for all security, authentication, and monetary state transitions.
business_invariants: All PII and sensitive payment keys must be redacted prior to write.
Audit log writes must be synchronous and fail-closed: if logger crashes, transaction aborts.
